Botão Desfazer ou aba Restauração: cada: Undo button or Restore tab: each value goes back to what it was (plugged in and on battery). If something changes outside the app, the card shows "Drifted" and the Reapply button.
CPU sempre no clock máximo: mais calor e: CPU always at maximum clock: more heat and noise, even when the PC is idle.
Cada configuração é lida com powercfg /q: Each setting is read with powercfg /qh before changing; those that don't exist on this machine are skipped (not applicable).
Clock estável e sem dispositivos \"adorm: Stable clock and no devices "falling asleep" during games. The average FPS gain is usually small (0 to 3%); the main benefit is stability and fewer stutters.
Cria (ou reutiliza) e ativa o plano \"Gu: Creates (or reuses) and activates the "Gueibs Optimizer Performance" plan, based on Ultimate Performance or High Performance, with display, sleep, hibernation and disk set to "Never" and wake timers disabled.
Mais calor, consumo de energia e ruído d: More heat, power use and fan noise, especially when the PC is idle. Processor idle states (C-states) are never disabled.
No plano Gueibs Optimizer Performance: p: In the Gueibs Optimizer Performance plan: processor always between 100% and 100%, aggressive boost, EPP 0, all cores active (core parking 100%) and active cooling, when the machine has these options. C-states are not changed.
No plano Gueibs Optimizer Performance: s: In the Gueibs Optimizer Performance plan: no USB selective suspend, no PCIe link power saving, Wi-Fi at maximum performance, media and video prioritizing performance, background slideshow paused and processor between 5% and 100%.
Plano de energia: dispositivos sem econo: Power plan: devices without power saving
Notebook detectado: este plano gasta mai: Laptop detected: this plan uses more battery. Timeouts are set to "Never" on battery too; performance settings change only when plugged in.
